propositions: A cancelled or timed-out job in the Verified Gate casts Verified -1 with message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that names no job and gives no reason, forcing manual triage of the run.
The gerrit-review-action hardcodes its message template and exposes no input for custom text, so detail cannot be delivered through enriching the vote message in place.
A timed-out job and a version-skew failure are indistinguishable in the vote, yet the first requires no author action while the second requires a rebase.

The summarizer maps GitHub job payloads plus check-run annotations to one line per non-successful job (name, TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED, duration, url) and returns empty string for all-successful runs.
Vote semantics are untouched; detail is posted as an additional comment-only SSH review carrying no label rather than by enriching the vote message.
